notes.title: "Chinese Football Simulator" Version 5.270 Update Notes
notes.content:
[p][b]"Chinese Football Simulator" Version 5.270 Update Notes:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Significantly optimized the loading speed of external full-body models.[/p][/*][*][p]Further improved the goalkeeper's saving logic, reducing instances of them "standing like a wooden chicken."[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed the issue of \["ridiculously high shots flying over the bar"] for better optimization.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the problem where \["missed shots veer way off target"] to improve accuracy.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted lower-skilled teams to correct the issue of \["matches being too smooth"] reported after the last update.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the display range of player names and stamina bars during matches to reduce visual clutter.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly optimized the field of view for the "third-person direct goal perspective."[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where sound effects for ball-related actions (e.g., touches, passes) were missing during matches.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where, during goal kicks, the ball would sometimes be launched without the goalkeeper touching it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where goalkeepers faced the wrong direction when taking goal kicks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem where players often tilted their necks unnaturally during matches.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, in certain cases, the goalkeeper's body model loaded incorrectly.[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p]

notes.title: "Chinese Football Simulator" DEMO V5.269 Update Notes
notes.content: [p][b]"Chinese Football Simulator" DEMO V5.269 Update Notes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]defenders reacted too slowly in transitioning to attacking positioning[/b] during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]forwards reacted too slowly in transitioning to defensive positioning[/b] during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]midfielders switched too late between attacking and defensive positioning[/b] during transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]goalkepers unnecessarily dove for very long/non-threatening shots[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug where [b]the ball would get stuck or fly erratically during set pieces[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]throw-in positions were occasionally unrealistic[/b] in the match engine.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]several minor UI-related bugs[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved overall passing fluidity[/b] in the match engine.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased penalty kick success rate[/b] in the match engine.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stronger teams now execute smoother attacking plays[/b] compared to weaker opponents.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Teams in possession now utilize wing play and pitch width more effectively[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Players will now shoot more decisively when given sufficient space[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a new "Third-Person Goal View" camera angle[/b], providing a more immersive and dynamic viewing experience.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: The new camera angle can be accessed by repeatedly clicking the "Switch Camera" button during matches.[/i][/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Official Update Notice "Chinese Football Simulator" v5.268
notes.content: [p][b]"Chinese Football Simulator" Version 5.268 Update Notes:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Added gradient colors and ability scales to address visibility issues with the ability bars.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an occasional bug where tactic board pieces would disappear after substitutions during matches.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where medium-range low-driven passes were sometimes too fast.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where transfer news failed to generate when advancing the schedule, causing the game to stall.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where youth academy news failed to generate when advancing the schedule, causing the game to stall.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where football association policy news failed to generate when advancing the schedule, causing the game to stall.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved quick-simulated matches to better reflect significant strength gaps between "clearly superior" teams.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved quick-simulated matches to ensure "overwhelming" ability advantages translate into more dominant victory margins.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved quick-simulated matches to reduce the likelihood of "extremely overwhelming" ability advantages still resulting in unexpected upsets.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced home team performance in quick-simulated matches, giving them a more noticeable advantage.[/p][/*][/olist][p]If you have any questions, feel free to join our official Discord server.[/p]

notes.title: Chinese Football Simulator demo Version 5.266 Update Notes:
notes.content: [olist][*][p]Adjusted the logic of the "Optimize Starting Lineup" feature—it now prioritizes player positional suitability over individual ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the simulation logic of the "Quick Simulate" feature, making simulations more in-depth and increasing randomness.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the "Optimize Starting Lineup" feature where players in poor form, injured, or suspended might still be selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in the "Quick Simulate" feature where injured or suspended players could occasionally score goals.[/p][/*][/olist][p]If you encounter any issues, feel free to join our official community group: [b]1036980858[/b] to provide feedback![/p][p]Every improvement is made possible thanks to your support. Wishing you all a great gaming experience and a weekend filled with both playing and watching football! Thank you![/p]

notes.title: "Chinese Football Simulator" demo Version 5.264 Update Notes:
notes.content: [h3][b]Chinese Football Simulator" Version 5.264 Patch Notes[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Optimized passing stutter and smoothness issues[/b], removing many poorly transitioning pass animations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved player animation logic[/b], now prioritizing accuracy over other factors.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced midfield central ball-holding logic[/b]—players now favor distributing the ball to the wings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Refined 30-meter zone ball control logic[/b]—wide players are more inclined to keep possession.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved midfield wing ball-holding logic[/b]—players now make fewer unnecessary floated crosses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimized backline passing choices[/b], blocking passes if opponents are within 30 meters of the passing lane.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusted shooting power[/b], reducing weak, "floaty" shots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved decision-making for contested aerial passes ("knife-edge" high balls)[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced teammate selection for headed passes[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved goalkeeper distribution after saves[/b]—keepers now prioritize safer passing options.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced and resized the stamina heart icon[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased the allowed shooting distance when a clear shot path exists[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced the occurrence of inexplicable, sudden back-passes in certain situations[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slightly improved turf texture quality[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed display issues for names containing rare characters during matches[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed occasional "double-kick" glitches during passing animations[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a "stamina percentage" display inside the stamina heart icon[/b] for clearer energy feedback.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Chinese Football Simulator – Update v5.257 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Thank you to all players who participated in the demo! We’ve received a wealth of valuable feedback and are now rolling out the first optimized version.[/p][p]The following fixes and improvements have been implemented:[/p][olist][*][p]Fixed UI display issues in the Quick Match interface.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Match Engine:[/b] Reduced the frequency of slide tackles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Match Engine:[/b] Adjusted overpowered headers to be less frequent.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Match Engine:[/b] Defenders will now clear the ball more decisively under heavy pressure.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Match Engine:[/b] Reduced the tendency to pass to teammates inside the defensive penalty area.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Match Engine:[/b] Fixed an issue with header chains after throw-ins.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Match Engine:[/b] Improved goalkeeper save decision-making.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed corner kick positioning being too far from the central area.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the homepage QR code linked to the wrong group (now updated to Group 3) and added QR code annotations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where attackers frequently performed unnecessary long back-passes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Match Engine:[/b] Free kicks inside the defensive penalty area are now taken by the goalkeeper.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Match Engine:[/b] Adjusted player behavior after kick-off to prevent excessive immediate goal rushes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Match Engine:[/b] Fixed an issue where throw-in takers occasionally appeared in incorrect positions.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Have feedback or suggestions? Join our official discord and share your thoughts—every piece of advice helps us create a better football simulation experience![/p]

notes.title: Chinese Football Simulator DEMO - Update 23
notes.content:
Update Notes:
Added a ⭐ symbol indicator for "Chosen One" players, making it easier to remember who they are.

Slightly increased the age of players acquired through the Yanbian Football School event.

Fixed an issue where the "Just pick one for me" defensive option during tactic creation didn't work.

Fixed validation issues in the first-team squad list.

Fixed validation issues in the tactics interface.

Fixed validation issues in the youth academy list.

Fixed inaccuracies in tactical effectiveness display during matches.

Improved the display of youth players' star ratings to reduce inflated values.

Optimized validation for friendly matches/training matches.

If any of these bugs reappear, please let me know—I'll promptly recheck and fix them.

Thank you all for your continuous feedback! New bugs are being logged constantly, and we're working hard to fix them in upcoming updates. Your understanding and active feedback are greatly appreciated. With every test, the game keeps getting better—thanks to you!
